answer: An operator copying one text across 177 aliases hence forfeits for 177 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. Since the anchor hash is stored at intake, the whisper graph groups the endorsements and the ocean audit reveals the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 6 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
